resolution_notes.integral: On the 28-dimensional integral cycle lattice, the plaquette boundary lattice has Smith form 1^24 and the full 66-face boundary lattice has Smith form 1^26,3^2, giving H1=(Z/3)^2 and H2=Z^38.
resolution_notes.attachment: The plaquette-only H1 is Z^4; affine-line triangles attach with nonzero Smith invariants 1,1,3,3, index 9.
resolution_notes.symmetry: AGL(2,3) preserves all faces. Its translation subgroup F3^2 is the exact kernel on H1(F3), and the image is GL(2,3), acting as a conjugate of det(M)M^T.
resolution_notes.separation: Pass5121 is a different 81x108 carrier with a one-dimensional Z/3 saturation quotient. No chain map or physical identification is asserted.
